milestone: Use Case Zero RootDID minting primitive + Factor-agent-callable-execution scoping
problem: Two ActivityActionType union members (agent_purpose_wallet_provisioned, agent_root_identity_sponsored) were added to services/receipts/activityReceiptService.ts across two earlier passes of this same session WITHOUT the matching activity_receipts_action_type_check constraint migration this codebase's own governing rule requires for every such addition — confirmed by tests/activity-receipts-action-type-parity.test.ts, which failed on exactly these two names when run.
observedFailure: tests/activity-receipts-action-type-parity.test.ts's 'every TypeScript ActivityActionType is present in the LATEST CHECK-constraint rebuild' assertion failed: missing = ['agent_root_identity_sponsored', 'agent_purpose_wallet_provisioned'].

Any live createActivityReceipt({ actionType: 'agent_purpose_wallet_provisioned' | 'agent_root_identity_sponsored', ... }) call against the real Supabase database would have been REJECTED by the activity_receipts_action_type_check CHECK constraint — the RootDID-genesis receipt in services/factor/useCaseZeroOrchestrator.ts's agentShell step, and the earlier wallet-provisioning receipts in the same file's ownerWallet/settlementWallet steps, would silently fail at the DB layer despite passing TypeScript compilation cleanly.

Neither addition was caught before this pass because the parity test was not run after either change — both were verified only via mocked unit tests (tests/use-case-zero-orchestrator.test.ts), which mock createActivityReceipt entirely and therefore never exercise the real CHECK constraint, the same class of gap the ON CONFLICT/partial-index defect earlier this session (RES-2026-09-07-BANKR-REHEARSAL-ONCONFLICT-PARTIAL-INDEX-001) also fell into: a TypeScript-level or mocked-unit-test pass cannot prove a live-database-level contract holds.
rootCauses: This codebase's own governing rule (stated in ~50 prior migration files' own headers, and in codexes/packs/agentiq/updates/... commit-message discipline) requires EVERY new ActivityActionType to ship with a wholesale-rebuild migration of activity_receipts_action_type_check in the SAME change — but nothing enforces this at the moment the TS union is edited; the parity test (tests/activity-receipts-action-type-parity.test.ts) is the ONLY thing that catches drift, and it must be actively run, not merely exist, to catch it.

Two separate additions in one session (agent_purpose_wallet_provisioned during the 'remaining Use Case Zero defects' pass, agent_root_identity_sponsored during the RootDID-minting-primitive pass) were each verified via their own scoped unit-test runs, never via a full/parity-test run — a scoped-test-only verification habit that misses any cross-cutting invariant a narrower test file doesn't itself check.
resolution: Added supabase/migrations/20260930260500_agent_wallet_and_rootdid_receipt_action_types.sql — a wholesale rebuild of activity_receipts_action_type_check carrying forward the complete prior list (transcribed from the immediately-prior migration, 20260930250000_confidential_projection_receipt_action_type.sql) plus exactly the two missing entries, per the established convention.

Applied the migration to the live Supabase project (mcp__Supabase__apply_migration) and verified tests/activity-receipts-action-type-parity.test.ts passes (was failing with exactly these 2 missing entries before the fix, now reports zero drift).
No application code changed — the TypeScript union additions were correct as written; only the missing database-constraint counterpart was added.
rejectedApproaches: Appending only the 2 new entries as a small ALTER, rather than a wholesale rebuild — rejected: this codebase's own established convention (every prior migration in this series) rebuilds the constraint wholesale specifically so a single file is always the complete, current source of truth for what the constraint allows; a partial append would break that invariant for the next agent extending it.

incidentRefs: Discovered while scoping capabilityRegistry registration for constitutional_financial_agent_establishment (2026-09-06) — running the pre-existing parity test as a sanity check before registering the capability surfaced the drift; not reported by the operator.
